title: Exploring Subjectivity for more Human-Centric Assessment of Social Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing automated pronoun-resolution benchmarks (e.g., Winogender) and advocating for human-centric evaluation that captures subtle sexism, non-binary gender identities, and subjective user disagreements through in-situ feedback.

Surveying and critiquing existing automated bias detection metrics, such as word/context embeddings, token probability measurements, and sentiment analysis of LLM text outputs, highlighting the need for human evaluation.
